description.en: Mist drifts across the paths above Crane Peak. Steep slopes fall away beyond the trees, and the mountain keeps the view to itself.
description.zh-CN: 你行走在华山之中，云雾缭绕，地势险峻。

description.en: Clouds drift across the high trail at Crane Peak. The ground drops steeply beyond the path, and the view comes and goes with the mist.
description.zh-CN: 你行走在华山之中，云雾缭绕，地势险峻。

description.en: The climb opens into a quiet glade behind Crane Peak. Wildflowers grow between the trees and rocks. Looking back, you can barely make out the path through the clouds.
description.zh-CN: 你好不容易爬上华山后山，回望来时的路，已经在云雾之中再也看不真切。此处地势忽然开阔，树林石缝之间不知名的野花丛生，不复山间险峻的情形。

华山后方的一个小山洞。.en: A small cave behind Crane Peak.
华山后方的一个小山洞。.zh-CN: 华山后方的一个小山洞。

text.en: Two swords, one road. Somehow, I still manage to take the wrong turn.
text.zh-CN: 两把剑，一条路。我居然还是能走错。

text.en: Miyamoto Musashi? I thought a sword master always knew the way.
text.zh-CN: 宫本武藏？我还以为，剑术大师从不会迷路。

text.en: Usually. Lately, I can barely get through a practice bout without coughing.
text.zh-CN: 通常不会。最近练上一阵，我就忍不住咳嗽。

text.en: I tried to settle a very stubborn argument with my training dummy.
text.zh-CN: 我和练习木人之间，起了一场谁也不服谁的争论。

text.en: The dummy. Apparently, explaining every swing is bad for my breathing.
text.zh-CN: 木人赢了。看来边挥剑边讲解，确实容易岔气。
真是个深藏不露的对手。

text.en: Since then, my breathing has been all wrong. Sword drills haven't helped.
text.zh-CN: 从那以后，我的呼吸就一直不顺，练剑也不见好。

text.en: Even masters need a second opinion sometimes.
text.zh-CN: 就算是大师，有时也该听听别人的意见。
最好找个没那么木讷的。

text.en: Travel with us. A good physician might have an answer.
text.zh-CN: 和我们同行吧，也许能找到有办法的名医。
